planets.name: HD 63433 d
planets.description: HD 63433 d crosses its star every 4.21 days and is 1.1 times as wide as Earth, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 63433 d was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 63433. Its orbit and size follow Capistrant et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
